messages:
marco: quick idea 

what if for tenant drains we send manifest-deltas instead of full lists? shrink payloads and avoid re-sending unchanged entries.


tess: interesting. how do we compute deltas reliably across coordinator restarts?

marco: coordinator keeps a concise snapshot per-target-node (base_manifest_id -> bloom/digest) and emits delta ops referencing base_manifest_id. node reconstructs by applying base + delta.

nora: GC question: how long do we keep base snapshots? we need retention + ack-based compaction so we don't hold forever.

marco: exactly. retention window + per-manifest ack counters. when all targets ack a base we can compact. also fallbacks: if node misses base_manifest, coordinator can resend a full manifest.

ops-bot: infra-note: delta-path reduces bandwidth but increases small-state; recommend default base_retention=10m for hosted clusters.

marco: another piece: optimistic-apply mode. node applies delta ops locally and streams tombstone/hint events immediately; coordinator waits for quorum-of-acks before committing manifest state.

tess: optimistic apply sounds fast but raises partial-visibility issues for readpaths.

luke: we can mitig by adding a cheap read guard: if prefix in pending_manifest_set, readpath does an owner-table check or consults owner node before returning cached value. cheap and conservative.

nora: failed-apply cases: nodes must return per-op failure reasons (cas-fail, ownership-mismatch, io). coordinator retries specific ops or falls back to full manifest.

marco: manifest entries will include expected_version + owner_epoch + owner_node so nodes can gate apply. that helps avoid split-brain.

dev-qa: testing matrix: reordering deltas, missing base, base prune during in-flight apply, owner transfer mid-manifest. will add sims.

ops-bot: deploy-bot: note - enable optimistic-apply behind a feature-flag. default off for multi-tenant clusters.

marco: metrics proposal: manifest_delta_size, fallback_rate (delta->full), optimistic_conflict_rate, per-prefix retry_count.

tess: UX ask: manifest inspector that shows base->delta chain and per-node reconstructed-status to make debugging easier.

marco: next steps: prototype delta chain + small gc service in staging; if results good i'll draft the RFC.

luke: I'll pair on readpath guards and the owner-check hooks.

tess: I'll own the inspector mockups and ops playbook for fallbacks.

marco: thanks all. will post prototype results next week. :thumbsup:
